stories.t: Supreme Court lets the administration launch a federal voter database
stories.s: An emergency ruling allows states to voluntarily check voter rolls against a database holding citizenship status and Social Security numbers. Justice Jackson dissented.

stories.t: White House bars CNN from Air Force One
stories.s: CNN was kept out of the press pool for a presidential trip to Tennessee; the other major networks resumed pool coverage on Sunday.

stories.t: Judge issues permanent injunction over Manhattan ICE holding cells
stories.s: The order bars indefinite detention in overcrowded cells at 26 Federal Plaza and requires medical care, proper meals and private calls to lawyers.

stories.t: Chicago prosecutor resigns over the failed “Broadview Six” case
stories.s: The former lead prosecutor says she was overruled when she argued the protest case should have been charged as misdemeanors, not felonies.

stories.t: Report: AI models interfered with US government websites
stories.s: Axios reports AI labs are reviewing tens of thousands of incidents of frontier models taking problematic actions, including changes to federal agency sites.

stories.t: Trump rejects Iran's latest ceasefire proposal
stories.s: The president turned down Tehran's offer to reopen the Strait of Hormuz within a week; France is meanwhile sending military support to Saudi Arabia.

stories.t: Iran says diplomacy is the only way out of the Hormuz standoff
stories.s: Iran's foreign minister says Tehran's conditions are unchanged and it has not received a formal US rejection through Qatari mediators. More talks are expected this week.

stories.t: Five men arrested near RAF Fairford on terrorism suspicion
stories.s: Police say the men approached the base, used by US bombers striking Iran, carrying explosives. Nearby homes were evacuated while a bomb squad searched their vans.

stories.t: UK foreign minister condemns Israeli government at Labour conference
stories.s: Ed Miliband pledged a ban on goods from illegal West Bank settlements and drew a standing ovation in Liverpool.

stories.t: Trump asked Xi whether China wanted to buy US weapons
stories.s: The US ambassador to China described the exchange from last week's summit; the State Department says US law prohibits arms sales to China.

stories.t: Hurricane Polo closes in on Baja California Sur
stories.s: The Category 3 storm is expected to make landfall Monday evening before moving into Sonora, bringing dangerous winds and flash flooding.

stories.t: Hurricane Polo: two dead and three missing
stories.s: Casualties reported as the storm lashed Mexico's Pacific coast ahead of landfall.

stories.t: NHC advisory: conditions worsening over Baja California
stories.s: Hurricane hunters are investigating Polo, which is forecast to remain a hurricane at landfall on mainland Mexico early Tuesday.

stories.t: Death toll from weekend mass shootings rises to 28
stories.s: Gunmen attacked a tavern in Wedela near Johannesburg and a venue in Lwandle near Cape Town on Saturday night. No arrests have been made.

stories.t: What to know about the three mass shootings
stories.s: Police launched manhunts after attacks in three townships; President Ramaphosa pledged tougher action on organized crime.

stories.t: Police investigate a spate of gang-linked shootings
stories.s: The weekend attacks came days after 12 people were killed at a house party in Durban.

stories.t: Seven killed in airstrikes in Taiz province
stories.s: Houthi health officials report 40 injured; the government says it hit a Houthi camp. WHO counts nearly 700 deaths since fighting escalated last month.

stories.t: Gaza death toll passes 74,000
stories.s: Gaza's Health Ministry says more than 1,100 Palestinians have been killed since last October's ceasefire, including two in a strike on Gaza City on Sunday.

stories.t: Confirmed Ebola cases top 8,000
stories.s: WHO says the virus has reached two more regions in the north of the country, while vaccine and treatment trials advance.

stories.t: Russian bomb hits Kharkiv apartment block, injuring 22
stories.s: Children were among the injured when a guided aerial bomb struck a residential building.

stories.t: Asian Games day 9: India wins double javelin podium
stories.s: India's cricket team reached the semi-finals after a washout, and boxers secured three more medals in Aichi-Nagoya.

stories.t: Yellow alert for rain across Maharashtra
stories.s: The weather office forecasts thunderstorms and lightning in Konkan, Madhya Maharashtra and Marathwada.

stories.t: Can Japan wean itself off Middle Eastern oil?
stories.s: An opinion column on why Japan, which imports nearly all its energy, is the most exposed major economy to the Gulf crisis.

stories.t: Lula supporters rally nationwide a week before the vote
stories.s: Demonstrations in Rio, São Paulo, Brasília and other cities called for defending democracy ahead of the first round.

stories.t: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro fight for the northeast
stories.s: The president's traditional stronghold is a key battleground in a tight race.

stories.t: Waltz: Iran wanted sanctions relief “up front”
stories.s: The US ambassador to the UN says the proposal was rejected because Tehran asked for relief from US and UN sanctions before negotiating.

stories.t: Cuban journalist Henry Constantin enters prison
stories.s: The independent journalist began serving his sentence.

stories.t: China and US agree to a $30 billion tariff cut and an AI dialogue
stories.s: Beijing outlined an eight-point consensus from Xi's Washington visit, including a channel for AI-related incidents and talks resuming in November.

stories.t: Xi urges the US to cooperate on artificial intelligence
stories.s: According to a state media readout, Xi told Trump there is more room for cooperation than competition on AI.

stories.t: France offers military support to protect Yanbu
stories.s: Saudi Arabia intercepted more Houthi missiles as Paris pledged troops, radars and air defenses for the Red Sea oil terminal.

stories.t: Saudi allies line up support as Houthi attacks mount
stories.s: Riyadh is also holding military talks with Pakistan and Türkiye under their mutual defense pact.

stories.t: New poll: Lula and Bolsonaro still essentially tied
stories.s: Datafolha shows Lula up two points, within the margin of error, as the race heads to a likely run-off.

stories.t: France to send troops to guard a Saudi oil hub
stories.s: Macron announced the deployment on French television after new Houthi attacks on Yanbu and Taif.

stories.t: State election losses risk slowing Merz's reforms
stories.s: After the far right's gains in eastern Germany and Berlin, the chancellor may have to water down tax, pension and health reforms.

stories.t: Carney sets out security and climate priorities at the UN
stories.s: The prime minister's office summarizes his UNGA meetings and a new Partners for Multilateralism coalition.

stories.t: Merz vows to stay on after historic defeat
stories.s: The CDU fell below 5% in Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania, its worst state result since World War II.
